attach smd: SMD attach (via or trace anchored to the center of a surface-mount pad)
autorouter: autorouter / auto-router (batch engine that routes nets with traces and vias)
bend cost: bend cost (penalty when a trace changes direction on a layer)
board outline: board outline (PCB edge boundary; copper must stay inside it)
clearance: clearance (minimum allowed distance between copper or mechanical features)
clearance class: clearance class (named spacing-rule group for traces, vias, and areas)
clearance matrix: clearance matrix (spacing table between item classes on a layer)
clearance violation: clearance violation (design-rule failure: items closer than allowed)
component: component (placed footprint instance on the board)
component keepout: component keepout / place keepout (zone where components must not be placed)
conduction area: conduction area (copper pour or plane tied to one net; Freerouting term)
courtyard: courtyard (minimum keepout around a component body)
DSN: DSN file (Specctra design format; keep the name DSN)
fab: fab layer (fabrication drawing: component body outline)
fanout: fanout (short escape traces and vias from dense pads, e.g. BGA)
gate: gate (Specctra logical pin group within a component)
gate pin: gate pin (Specctra pin referenced through a gate)
keepout: keepout (zone where traces, vias, or placement are forbidden)
layer: layer (copper, mask, silkscreen, or documentation plane)
logical part: logical part (Specctra component definition before placement)
neckdown: neckdown (automatic trace-width reduction at a narrower pad)
net: net (electrical connection grouping all pins that must be connected)
net class: net class (shared routing rules: width, via rule, clearance)
obstacle area: obstacle area (copper or mechanical area that blocks routing)
optimizer: optimizer (post-routing pass that shortens and cleans up traces)
padstack: padstack (pad and drill pattern for a pin or via on each layer)
pin: pin (component terminal to be connected by copper)
power plane: power plane (copper pour used for power or ground)
preferred direction: preferred direction (horizontal or vertical routing bias per layer)
pull tight: pull tight (straighten and optimize existing trace geometry)
push and shove: push & shove (interactive routing that displaces existing traces)
ratsnest: ratsnest / air wires (lines showing still-unrouted connections)
ripup: rip-up (remove trace segments so a net can be rerouted)
SES: SES file (Specctra session containing routing results)
shove fixed: shove fixed (net whose traces cannot be displaced by push/shove)
signal layer: signal layer (copper layer used for trace routing, not plane-only)
SMD: SMD (surface-mount pad; not a through-hole pin)
Specctra: Specctra / Electra DSN (PCB interchange format used by Freerouting)
stitch mode: stitch mode (routing mode for shove-fixed nets that must stay in place)
terminal item: terminal item (route endpoint: pin, via, or conduction area)
trace: trace / track (copper conductor on one layer)
trace length: trace length (routed length of a copper segment)
trace width: trace width (copper width of a trace)
unroute: unroute (remove finished routing from items or nets)
unrouted: unrouted (not yet connected by finished copper)
via: via (plated hole connecting traces on different layers)
via keepout: via keepout (zone where vias are forbidden)
via rule: via rule (allowed via padstacks and layer spans for a net class)
